terms.comment: A description of ours: compitum, the classical word for a crossroads, and rotundus, round. No reference work we searched (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini, Andresian) has a word for a roundabout. The fairground roundabout is under “merry-go-round”.

phrases.latin: Ubi ad compitum rotundum vēnerimus, tertiā viā exībimus.
phrases.english: When we get to the roundabout, we’ll take the third exit.
The cars drive round the roundabout.

sources: Lewis & Short: compitum · Lewis & Short: rotundus
